about.title: About me
about.metaDescription: About Daan van Vugt: software development across mobile and web, making games, producing bass music, and cinema.

biography.introduction: Hi, I’m Daan van Vugt, a software developer with three years of experience building mobile apps and web tools. At <experience>Valk Digital</experience>, I worked across the stack in a small team. Some days I was polishing a hotel booking flow in React Native. Other days I was figuring out how to sync housekeeping tasks after a device came back online or why a back-office page was slow.
biography.approach: I like getting to the bottom of a problem and seeing the fix through to release. I’m happy moving between frontend and backend, and I tend to leave the code a little easier to work with than I found it, whether that means simplifying a component or adding a test for a bug I just tracked down.
biography.personal: Outside work, I make games, produce bass music in Ableton Live, and love going to the cinema. I’m building <divergence>Divergence</divergence>, a Game Boy Advance project written in C, and designing Phantasm, a tactical autobattler. I can happily spend an evening tweaking a game mechanic, getting a bass sound to sit right in a track, or catching a film on the big screen.
